59/**
60 * Encoder that encodes minimally
61 *
62 * Algorithm:
63 *
64 * The eleventh commandment was "Thou Shalt Compute" or "Thou Shalt Not Compute" - I forget which (Alan Perilis).
65 *
66 * This implementation computes. As an alternative, the QR-Code specification suggests heuristics like this one:
67 *
68 * If initial input data is in the exclusive subset of the Alphanumeric character set AND if there are less than
69 * [6,7,8] characters followed by data from the remainder of the 8-bit byte character set, THEN select the 8-
70 * bit byte mode ELSE select Alphanumeric mode;
71 *
72 * This is probably right for 99.99% of cases but there is at least this one counter example: The string "AAAAAAa"
73 * encodes 2 bits smaller as ALPHANUMERIC(AAAAAA), BYTE(a) than by encoding it as BYTE(AAAAAAa).
74 * Perhaps that is the only counter example but without having proof, it remains unclear.
75 *
76 * ECI switching:
77 *
78 * In multi language content the algorithm selects the most compact representation using ECI modes.
79 * For example the most compact representation of the string "\u0150\u015C" (O-double-acute, S-circumflex) is
80 * ECI(UTF-8), BYTE(\u0150\u015C) while prepending one or more times the same leading character as in
81 * "\u0150\u0150\u015C", the most compact representation uses two ECIs so that the string is encoded as
82 * ECI(ISO-8859-2), BYTE(\u0150\u0150), ECI(ISO-8859-3), BYTE(\u015C).
83 *
84 * @author Alex Geller
85 */
86pub struct MinimalEncoder {
87    stringToEncode: Vec<String>,
88    isGS1: bool,
89    encoders: ECIEncoderSet,
90    ecLevel: ErrorCorrectionLevel,
91}
92
93impl MinimalEncoder {
94    /**
95     * Creates a MinimalEncoder
96     *
97     * @param stringToEncode The string to encode
98     * @param priorityCharset The preferred {@link Charset}. When the value of the argument is null, the algorithm
99     *   chooses charsets that leads to a minimal representation. Otherwise the algorithm will use the priority
100     *   charset to encode any character in the input that can be encoded by it if the charset is among the
101     *   supported charsets.
102     * @param isGS1 {@code true} if a FNC1 is to be prepended; {@code false} otherwise
103     * @param ecLevel The error correction level.
104     * @see RXingResultList#getVersion
105     */
106    pub fn new(
107        stringToEncode: &str,
108        priorityCharset: Option<CharacterSet>,
109        isGS1: bool,
110        ecLevel: ErrorCorrectionLevel,
111    ) -> Self {
112        Self {
113            stringToEncode: stringToEncode
114                .graphemes(true)
115                .map(|p| p.to_owned())
116                .collect::<Vec<String>>(),
117            isGS1,
118            encoders: ECIEncoderSet::new(stringToEncode, priorityCharset, None),
119            ecLevel,
120        }
121    }
122
123    /**
124     * Encodes the string minimally
125     *
126     * @param stringToEncode The string to encode
127     * @param version The preferred {@link Version}. A minimal version is computed (see
128     *   {@link RXingResultList#getVersion method} when the value of the argument is null
129     * @param priorityCharset The preferred {@link Charset}. When the value of the argument is null, the algorithm
130     *   chooses charsets that leads to a minimal representation. Otherwise the algorithm will use the priority
131     *   charset to encode any character in the input that can be encoded by it if the charset is among the
132     *   supported charsets.
133     * @param isGS1 {@code true} if a FNC1 is to be prepended; {@code false} otherwise
134     * @param ecLevel The error correction level.
135     * @return An instance of {@code RXingResultList} representing the minimal solution.
136     * @see RXingResultList#getBits
137     * @see RXingResultList#getVersion
138     * @see RXingResultList#getSize
139     */
140    pub fn encode_with_details(
141        stringToEncode: &str,
142        version: Option<VersionRef>,
143        priorityCharset: Option<CharacterSet>,
144        isGS1: bool,
145        ecLevel: ErrorCorrectionLevel,
146    ) -> Result<RXingResultList> {
147        MinimalEncoder::new(stringToEncode, priorityCharset, isGS1, ecLevel).encode(version)
148    }
149
150    pub fn encode(&self, version: Option<VersionRef>) -> Result<RXingResultList> {
151        if let Some(version) = version {
152            // compute minimal encoding for a given version
153            let result = self.encodeSpecificVersion(version)?;
154            if !qrcode_encoder::willFit(
155                result.getSize(),
156                Self::getVersion(Self::getVersionSize(result.getVersion()))?,
157                &self.ecLevel,
158            ) {
159                return Err(Exceptions::writer_with(format!(
160                    "Data too big for version {version}"
161                )));
162            }
163            Ok(result)
164        } else {
165            // compute minimal encoding trying the three version sizes.
166            let versions = [
167                Self::getVersion(VersionSize::SMALL)?,
168                Self::getVersion(VersionSize::MEDIUM)?,
169                Self::getVersion(VersionSize::LARGE)?,
170            ];
171            let results = [
172                self.encodeSpecificVersion(versions[0])?,
173                self.encodeSpecificVersion(versions[1])?,
174                self.encodeSpecificVersion(versions[2])?,
175            ];
176            let mut smallestSize = u32::MAX;
177            let mut smallestRXingResult: i32 = -1;
178            for i in 0..3 {
179                let size = results[i].getSize();
180                if qrcode_encoder::willFit(size, versions[i], &self.ecLevel) && size < smallestSize
181                {
182                    smallestSize = size;
183                    smallestRXingResult = i as i32;
184                }
185            }
186            if smallestRXingResult < 0 {
187                return Err(Exceptions::writer_with("Data too big for any version"));
188            }
189            Ok(results[smallestRXingResult as usize].clone())
190        }
191    }
192
193    pub fn getVersionSize(version: VersionRef) -> VersionSize {
194        match version.getVersionNumber() {
195            0..=9 => VersionSize::SMALL,
196            10..=26 => VersionSize::MEDIUM,
197            _ => VersionSize::LARGE,
198        }
199    }
200
201    pub fn getVersion(versionSize: VersionSize) -> Result<VersionRef> {
202        match versionSize {
203            VersionSize::SMALL => Version::getVersionForNumber(9),
204            VersionSize::MEDIUM => Version::getVersionForNumber(26),
205            VersionSize::LARGE => Version::getVersionForNumber(40),
206        }
207    }
208
209    pub fn isNumeric(c: &str) -> bool {
210        if c.len() == 1 {
211            if let Some(ch) = c.chars().next() {
212                return ch.is_ascii_digit();
213            }
214        }
215        false
216    }
217
218    pub fn isDoubleByteKanji(c: &str) -> bool {
219        qrcode_encoder::isOnlyDoubleByteKanji(c)
220    }
221
222    pub fn isAlphanumeric(c: &str) -> bool {
223        if c.len() == 1 {
224            if let Some(ch) = c.chars().next() {
225                return qrcode_encoder::getAlphanumericCode(ch as u32) != -1;
226            }
227        }
228        false
229    }
230
231    pub fn canEncode(&self, mode: &Mode, c: &str) -> bool {
232        match mode {
233            Mode::NUMERIC => Self::isNumeric(c),
234            Mode::ALPHANUMERIC => Self::isAlphanumeric(c),
235            Mode::BYTE => true,
236            Mode::KANJI => Self::isDoubleByteKanji(c),
237            _ => false, // any character can be encoded as byte(s). Up to the caller to manage splitting into
238                        // multiple bytes when String.getBytes(Charset) return more than one byte.
239        }
240    }
241
242    pub fn getCompactedOrdinal(mode: Option<Mode>) -> Result<u32> {
243        match mode {
244            Some(Mode::NUMERIC) => Ok(2),
245            Some(Mode::ALPHANUMERIC) => Ok(1),
246            Some(Mode::BYTE) => Ok(3),
247            Some(Mode::KANJI) | None => Ok(0),
248            _ => Err(Exceptions::illegal_argument_with(format!(
249                "Illegal mode {mode:?}"
250            ))),
251        }
252    }
253
254    pub fn addEdge(
255        &self,
256        edges: &mut [Vec<Vec<Option<Arc<Edge>>>>],
257        position: usize,
258        edge: Option<Arc<Edge>>,
259    ) -> Result<()> {
260        let vertexIndex =
261            position + edge.as_ref().ok_or(Exceptions::FORMAT)?.characterLength as usize;
262        let modeEdges =
263            &mut edges[vertexIndex][edge.as_ref().ok_or(Exceptions::FORMAT)?.charsetEncoderIndex];
264        let modeOrdinal =
265            Self::getCompactedOrdinal(Some(edge.as_ref().ok_or(Exceptions::FORMAT)?.mode))?
266                as usize;
267        if modeEdges[modeOrdinal].is_none()
268            || modeEdges[modeOrdinal]
269                .as_ref()
270                .ok_or(Exceptions::FORMAT)?
271                .cachedTotalSize
272                > edge.as_ref().ok_or(Exceptions::FORMAT)?.cachedTotalSize
273        {
274            modeEdges[modeOrdinal] = edge;
275        }
276
277        Ok(())
278    }
279
280    pub fn addEdges(
281        &self,
282        version: VersionRef,
283        edges: &mut [Vec<Vec<Option<Arc<Edge>>>>],
284        from: usize,
285        previous: Option<Arc<Edge>>,
286    ) -> Result<()> {
287        let mut start = 0;
288        let mut end = self.encoders.len();
289        let priorityEncoderIndex = self.encoders.getPriorityEncoderIndex();
290        if priorityEncoderIndex.is_some()
291            && self
292                .encoders
293                .canEncode(
294                    &self.stringToEncode[from],
295                    priorityEncoderIndex.ok_or(Exceptions::FORMAT)?,
296                )
297                .ok_or(Exceptions::FORMAT)?
298        {
299            start = priorityEncoderIndex.ok_or(Exceptions::FORMAT)?;
300            end = priorityEncoderIndex.ok_or(Exceptions::FORMAT)? + 1;
301        }
302
303        for i in start..end {
304            if self
305                .encoders
306                .canEncode(
307                    self.stringToEncode
308                        .get(from)
309                        .ok_or(Exceptions::INDEX_OUT_OF_BOUNDS)?,
310                    i,
311                )
312                .ok_or(Exceptions::FORMAT)?
313            {
314                self.addEdge(
315                    edges,
316                    from,
317                    Some(Arc::new(
318                        Edge::new(
319                            Mode::BYTE,
320                            from,
321                            i,
322                            1,
323                            previous.clone(),
324                            version,
325                            self.encoders.clone(),
326                            self.stringToEncode.clone(),
327                        )
328                        .ok_or(Exceptions::WRITER)?,
329                    )),
330                )?;
331            }
332        }
333
334        if self.canEncode(
335            &Mode::KANJI,
336            self.stringToEncode.get(from).ok_or(Exceptions::FORMAT)?,
337        ) {
338            self.addEdge(
339                edges,
340                from,
341                Some(Arc::new(
342                    Edge::new(
343                        Mode::KANJI,
344                        from,
345                        0,
346                        1,
347                        previous.clone(),
348                        version,
349                        self.encoders.clone(),
350                        self.stringToEncode.clone(),
351                    )
352                    .ok_or(Exceptions::WRITER)?,
353                )),
354            )?;
355        }
356
357        let inputLength = self.stringToEncode.len();
358        if self.canEncode(
359            &Mode::ALPHANUMERIC,
360            self.stringToEncode
361                .get(from)
362                .ok_or(Exceptions::INDEX_OUT_OF_BOUNDS)?,
363        ) {
364            self.addEdge(
365                edges,
366                from,
367                Some(Arc::new(
368                    Edge::new(
369                        Mode::ALPHANUMERIC,
370                        from,
371                        0,
372                        if from + 1 >= inputLength
373                            || !self.canEncode(
374                                &Mode::ALPHANUMERIC,
375                                self.stringToEncode
376                                    .get(from + 1)
377                                    .ok_or(Exceptions::INDEX_OUT_OF_BOUNDS)?,
378                            )
379                        {
380                            1
381                        } else {
382                            2
383                        },
384                        previous.clone(),
385                        version,
386                        self.encoders.clone(),
387                        self.stringToEncode.clone(),
388                    )
389                    .ok_or(Exceptions::WRITER)?,
390                )),
391            )?;
392        }
393
394        if self.canEncode(
395            &Mode::NUMERIC,
396            self.stringToEncode
397                .get(from)
398                .ok_or(Exceptions::INDEX_OUT_OF_BOUNDS)?,
399        ) {
400            self.addEdge(
401                edges,
402                from,
403                Some(Arc::new(
404                    Edge::new(
405                        Mode::NUMERIC,
406                        from,
407                        0,
408                        if from + 1 >= inputLength
409                            || !self.canEncode(
410                                &Mode::NUMERIC,
411                                self.stringToEncode
412                                    .get(from + 1)
413                                    .ok_or(Exceptions::INDEX_OUT_OF_BOUNDS)?,
414                            )
415                        {
416                            1
417                        } else if from + 2 >= inputLength
418                            || !self.canEncode(
419                                &Mode::NUMERIC,
420                                self.stringToEncode
421                                    .get(from + 2)
422                                    .ok_or(Exceptions::INDEX_OUT_OF_BOUNDS)?,
423                            )
424                        {
425                            2
426                        } else {
427                            3
428                        },
429                        previous,
430                        version,
431                        self.encoders.clone(),
432                        self.stringToEncode.clone(),
433                    )
434                    .ok_or(Exceptions::WRITER)?,
435                )),
436            )?;
437        }
438
439        Ok(())
440    }
441    pub fn encodeSpecificVersion(&self, version: VersionRef) -> Result<RXingResultList> {
442        // @SuppressWarnings("checkstyle:lineLength")
443        /* A vertex represents a tuple of a position in the input, a mode and a character encoding where position 0
444         * denotes the position left of the first character, 1 the position left of the second character and so on.
445         * Likewise the end vertices are located after the last character at position stringToEncode.length().
446         *
447         * An edge leading to such a vertex encodes one or more of the characters left of the position that the vertex
448         * represents and encodes it in the same encoding and mode as the vertex on which the edge ends. In other words,
449         * all edges leading to a particular vertex encode the same characters in the same mode with the same character
450         * encoding. They differ only by their source vertices who are all located at i+1 minus the number of encoded
451         * characters.
452         *
453         * The edges leading to a vertex are stored in such a way that there is a fast way to enumerate the edges ending
454         * on a particular vertex.
455         *
456         * The algorithm processes the vertices in order of their position thereby performing the following:
457         *
458         * For every vertex at position i the algorithm enumerates the edges ending on the vertex and removes all but the
459         * shortest from that list.
460         * Then it processes the vertices for the position i+1. If i+1 == stringToEncode.length() then the algorithm ends
461         * and chooses the the edge with the smallest size from any of the edges leading to vertices at this position.
462         * Otherwise the algorithm computes all possible outgoing edges for the vertices at the position i+1
463         *
464         * Examples:
465         * The process is illustrated by showing the graph (edges) after each iteration from left to right over the input:
466         * An edge is drawn as follows "(" + fromVertex + ") -- " + encodingMode + "(" + encodedInput + ") (" +
467         * accumulatedSize + ") --> (" + toVertex + ")"
468         *
469         * Example 1 encoding the string "ABCDE":
470         * Note: This example assumes that alphanumeric encoding is only possible in multiples of two characters so that
471         * the example is both short and showing the principle. In reality this restriction does not exist.
472         *
473         * Initial situation
474         * (initial) -- BYTE(A) (20) --> (1_BYTE)
475         * (initial) -- ALPHANUMERIC(AB)                     (24) --> (2_ALPHANUMERIC)
476         *
477         * Situation after adding edges to vertices at position 1
478         * (initial) -- BYTE(A) (20) --> (1_BYTE) -- BYTE(B) (28) --> (2_BYTE)
479         *                               (1_BYTE) -- ALPHANUMERIC(BC)                             (44) --> (3_ALPHANUMERIC)
480         * (initial) -- ALPHANUMERIC(AB)                     (24) --> (2_ALPHANUMERIC)
481         *
482         * Situation after adding edges to vertices at position 2
483         * (initial) -- BYTE(A) (20) --> (1_BYTE)
484         * (initial) -- ALPHANUMERIC(AB)                     (24) --> (2_ALPHANUMERIC)
485         * (initial) -- BYTE(A) (20) --> (1_BYTE) -- BYTE(B) (28) --> (2_BYTE)
486         * (1_BYTE) -- ALPHANUMERIC(BC)                             (44) --> (3_ALPHANUMERIC)
487         * (initial) -- ALPHANUMERIC(AB)                     (24) --> (2_ALPHANUMERIC) -- BYTE(C) (44) --> (3_BYTE)
488         *                                                            (2_ALPHANUMERIC) -- ALPHANUMERIC(CD)                             (35) --> (4_ALPHANUMERIC)
489         *
490         * Situation after adding edges to vertices at position 3
491         * (initial) -- BYTE(A) (20) --> (1_BYTE) -- BYTE(B) (28) --> (2_BYTE) -- BYTE(C)         (36) --> (3_BYTE)
492         *                               (1_BYTE) -- ALPHANUMERIC(BC)                             (44) --> (3_ALPHANUMERIC) -- BYTE(D) (64) --> (4_BYTE)
493         *                                                                                                 (3_ALPHANUMERIC) -- ALPHANUMERIC(DE)                             (55) --> (5_ALPHANUMERIC)
494         * (initial) -- ALPHANUMERIC(AB)                     (24) --> (2_ALPHANUMERIC) -- ALPHANUMERIC(CD)                             (35) --> (4_ALPHANUMERIC)
495         *                                                            (2_ALPHANUMERIC) -- ALPHANUMERIC(CD)                             (35) --> (4_ALPHANUMERIC)
496         *
497         * Situation after adding edges to vertices at position 4
498         * (initial) -- BYTE(A) (20) --> (1_BYTE) -- BYTE(B) (28) --> (2_BYTE) -- BYTE(C)         (36) --> (3_BYTE) -- BYTE(D) (44) --> (4_BYTE)
499         *                               (1_BYTE) -- ALPHANUMERIC(BC)                             (44) --> (3_ALPHANUMERIC) -- ALPHANUMERIC(DE)                             (55) --> (5_ALPHANUMERIC)
500         * (initial) -- ALPHANUMERIC(AB)                     (24) --> (2_ALPHANUMERIC) -- ALPHANUMERIC(CD)                             (35) --> (4_ALPHANUMERIC) -- BYTE(E) (55) --> (5_BYTE)
501         *
502         * Situation after adding edges to vertices at position 5
503         * (initial) -- BYTE(A) (20) --> (1_BYTE) -- BYTE(B) (28) --> (2_BYTE) -- BYTE(C)         (36) --> (3_BYTE) -- BYTE(D)         (44) --> (4_BYTE) -- BYTE(E)         (52) --> (5_BYTE)
504         *                               (1_BYTE) -- ALPHANUMERIC(BC)                             (44) --> (3_ALPHANUMERIC) -- ALPHANUMERIC(DE)                             (55) --> (5_ALPHANUMERIC)
505         * (initial) -- ALPHANUMERIC(AB)                     (24) --> (2_ALPHANUMERIC) -- ALPHANUMERIC(CD)                             (35) --> (4_ALPHANUMERIC)
506         *
507         * Encoding as BYTE(ABCDE) has the smallest size of 52 and is hence chosen. The encodation ALPHANUMERIC(ABCD),
508         * BYTE(E) is longer with a size of 55.
509         *
510         * Example 2 encoding the string "XXYY" where X denotes a character unique to character set ISO-8859-2 and Y a
511         * character unique to ISO-8859-3. Both characters encode as double byte in UTF-8:
512         *
513         * Initial situation
514         * (initial) -- BYTE(X) (32) --> (1_BYTE_ISO-8859-2)
515         * (initial) -- BYTE(X) (40) --> (1_BYTE_UTF-8)
516         * (initial) -- BYTE(X) (40) --> (1_BYTE_UTF-16BE)
517         *
518         * Situation after adding edges to vertices at position 1
519         * (initial) -- BYTE(X) (32) --> (1_BYTE_ISO-8859-2) -- BYTE(X) (40) --> (2_BYTE_ISO-8859-2)
520         *                               (1_BYTE_ISO-8859-2) -- BYTE(X) (72) --> (2_BYTE_UTF-8)
521         *                               (1_BYTE_ISO-8859-2) -- BYTE(X) (72) --> (2_BYTE_UTF-16BE)
522         * (initial) -- BYTE(X) (40) --> (1_BYTE_UTF-8)
523         * (initial) -- BYTE(X) (40) --> (1_BYTE_UTF-16BE)
524         *
525         * Situation after adding edges to vertices at position 2
526         * (initial) -- BYTE(X) (32) --> (1_BYTE_ISO-8859-2) -- BYTE(X) (40) --> (2_BYTE_ISO-8859-2)
527         *                                                                       (2_BYTE_ISO-8859-2) -- BYTE(Y) (72) --> (3_BYTE_ISO-8859-3)
528         *                                                                       (2_BYTE_ISO-8859-2) -- BYTE(Y) (80) --> (3_BYTE_UTF-8)
529         *                                                                       (2_BYTE_ISO-8859-2) -- BYTE(Y) (80) --> (3_BYTE_UTF-16BE)
530         * (initial) -- BYTE(X) (40) --> (1_BYTE_UTF-8) -- BYTE(X) (56) --> (2_BYTE_UTF-8)
531         * (initial) -- BYTE(X) (40) --> (1_BYTE_UTF-16BE) -- BYTE(X) (56) --> (2_BYTE_UTF-16BE)
532         *
533         * Situation after adding edges to vertices at position 3
534         * (initial) -- BYTE(X) (32) --> (1_BYTE_ISO-8859-2) -- BYTE(X) (40) --> (2_BYTE_ISO-8859-2) -- BYTE(Y) (72) --> (3_BYTE_ISO-8859-3)
535         *                                                                                                               (3_BYTE_ISO-8859-3) -- BYTE(Y) (80) --> (4_BYTE_ISO-8859-3)
536         *                                                                                                               (3_BYTE_ISO-8859-3) -- BYTE(Y) (112) --> (4_BYTE_UTF-8)
537         *                                                                                                               (3_BYTE_ISO-8859-3) -- BYTE(Y) (112) --> (4_BYTE_UTF-16BE)
538         * (initial) -- BYTE(X) (40) --> (1_BYTE_UTF-8) -- BYTE(X) (56) --> (2_BYTE_UTF-8) -- BYTE(Y) (72) --> (3_BYTE_UTF-8)
539         * (initial) -- BYTE(X) (40) --> (1_BYTE_UTF-16BE) -- BYTE(X) (56) --> (2_BYTE_UTF-16BE) -- BYTE(Y) (72) --> (3_BYTE_UTF-16BE)
540         *
541         * Situation after adding edges to vertices at position 4
542         * (initial) -- BYTE(X) (32) --> (1_BYTE_ISO-8859-2) -- BYTE(X) (40) --> (2_BYTE_ISO-8859-2) -- BYTE(Y) (72) --> (3_BYTE_ISO-8859-3) -- BYTE(Y) (80) --> (4_BYTE_ISO-8859-3)
543         *                                                                                                               (3_BYTE_UTF-8) -- BYTE(Y) (88) --> (4_BYTE_UTF-8)
544         *                                                                                                               (3_BYTE_UTF-16BE) -- BYTE(Y) (88) --> (4_BYTE_UTF-16BE)
545         * (initial) -- BYTE(X) (40) --> (1_BYTE_UTF-8) -- BYTE(X) (56) --> (2_BYTE_UTF-8) -- BYTE(Y) (72) --> (3_BYTE_UTF-8)
546         * (initial) -- BYTE(X) (40) --> (1_BYTE_UTF-16BE) -- BYTE(X) (56) --> (2_BYTE_UTF-16BE) -- BYTE(Y) (72) --> (3_BYTE_UTF-16BE)
547         *
548         * Encoding as ECI(ISO-8859-2),BYTE(XX),ECI(ISO-8859-3),BYTE(YY) has the smallest size of 80 and is hence chosen.
549         * The encodation ECI(UTF-8),BYTE(XXYY) is longer with a size of 88.
550         */
551
552        // let inputLength = self.stringToEncode.chars().count();
553        let inputLength = self.stringToEncode.len();
554
555        // Array that represents vertices. There is a vertex for every character, encoding and mode. The vertex contains
556        // a list of all edges that lead to it that have the same encoding and mode.
557        // The lists are created lazily
558
559        // The last dimension in the array below encodes the 4 modes KANJI, ALPHANUMERIC, NUMERIC and BYTE via the
560        // function getCompactedOrdinal(Mode)
561        let mut edges = vec![vec![vec![None; 4]; self.encoders.len()]; inputLength + 1];
562        self.addEdges(version, &mut edges, 0, None)?;
563
564        for i in 1..=inputLength {
565            for j in 0..self.encoders.len() {
566                for k in 0..4 {
567                    if edges[i][j][k].is_some() && i < inputLength {
568                        let e = edges[i][j][k].clone();
569                        self.addEdges(version, &mut edges, i, e)?;
570                    }
571                }
572            }
573        }
574        let mut minimalJ = None;
575        let mut minimalK = None;
576        let mut minimalSize = u32::MAX;
577        for j in 0..self.encoders.len() {
578            for k in 0..4 {
579                if let Some(edge) = &edges[inputLength][j][k] {
580                    if edge.cachedTotalSize < minimalSize {
581                        minimalSize = edge.cachedTotalSize;
582                        minimalJ = Some(j);
583                        minimalK = Some(k);
584                    }
585                }
586            }
587        }
588
589        if let Some((minJ, minK)) = minimalJ.zip(minimalK) {
590            Ok(RXingResultList::new(
591                version,
592                edges[inputLength][minJ][minK]
593                    .as_ref()
594                    .ok_or(Exceptions::WRITER)?
595                    .clone(),
596                self.isGS1,
597                &self.ecLevel,
598                self.encoders.clone(),
599                self.stringToEncode.clone(),
600            )
601            .ok_or(Exceptions::WRITER)?)
602        } else {
603            Err(Exceptions::writer_with(format!(
604                r#"Internal error: failed to encode "{}"#,
605                self.stringToEncode
606                    .iter()
607                    .map(String::from)
608                    .collect::<String>()
609            )))
610        }
611    }
612}

614pub struct Edge {
615    pub mode: Mode,
616    fromPosition: usize,
617    charsetEncoderIndex: usize,
618    characterLength: u32,
619    previous: Option<Arc<Edge>>,
620    cachedTotalSize: u32,
621    _encoders: ECIEncoderSet,
622    _stringToEncode: Vec<String>,
623}
624impl Edge {
625    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
626    pub fn new(
627        mode: Mode,
628        fromPosition: usize,
629        charsetEncoderIndex: usize,
630        characterLength: u32,
631        previous: Option<Arc<Edge>>,
632        version: VersionRef,
633        encoders: ECIEncoderSet,
634        stringToEncode: Vec<String>,
635    ) -> Option<Self> {
636        let nci = if mode == Mode::BYTE || previous.is_none() {
637            charsetEncoderIndex
638        } else {
639            previous.as_ref()?.charsetEncoderIndex
640        };
641
642        Some(Self {
643            mode,
644            fromPosition,
645            charsetEncoderIndex: nci,
646            characterLength,
647            previous: previous.clone(),
648            _stringToEncode: stringToEncode.clone(),
649            cachedTotalSize: {
650                let mut size = if previous.is_some() {
651                    previous.as_ref()?.cachedTotalSize
652                } else {
653                    0
654                };
655
656                let needECI = mode == Mode::BYTE &&
657                          (previous.is_none() && nci != 0) || // at the beginning and charset is not ISO-8859-1
658                          (previous.is_some() && nci != previous.as_ref()?.charsetEncoderIndex);
659
660                if previous.is_none() || mode != previous.as_ref()?.mode || needECI {
661                    size += 4 + mode.getCharacterCountBits(version) as u32;
662                }
663                match mode {
664                    Mode::NUMERIC => {
665                        size += if characterLength == 1 {
666                            4
667                        } else if characterLength == 2 {
668                            7
669                        } else {
670                            10
671                        }
672                    }
673                    Mode::ALPHANUMERIC => size += if characterLength == 1 { 6 } else { 11 },
674                    Mode::BYTE => {
675                        let n: String = stringToEncode
676                            .iter()
677                            .skip(fromPosition)
678                            .take(characterLength as usize)
679                            .map(String::from)
680                            .collect();
681                        size += 8 * encoders.encode_string(&n, charsetEncoderIndex)?.len() as u32;
682                        if needECI {
683                            size += 4 + 8; // the ECI assignment numbers for ISO-8859-x, UTF-8 and UTF-16 are all 8 bit long
684                        }
685                    }
686                    Mode::KANJI => size += 13,
687                    _ => {}
688                }
689                size
690            },
691            _encoders: encoders,
692        })
693    }
694}

696#[derive(Clone)]
697pub struct RXingResultList {
698    list: Vec<RXingResultNode>,
699    version: VersionRef,
700}
701impl RXingResultList {
702    pub fn new(
703        version: VersionRef,
704        solution: Arc<Edge>,
705        isGS1: bool,
706        ecLevel: &ErrorCorrectionLevel,
707        encoders: ECIEncoderSet,
708        stringToEncode: Vec<String>,
709    ) -> Option<Self> {
710        let mut length = 0;
711        let mut current = Some(solution);
712        let mut containsECI = false;
713        let mut list = Vec::new();
714
715        while let Some(loop_current) = &current {
716            length += loop_current.characterLength;
717            let previous = current.as_ref()?.previous.clone();
718
719            let needECI = loop_current.mode == Mode::BYTE &&
720          (previous.is_none() && loop_current.charsetEncoderIndex != 0) || // at the beginning and charset is not ISO-8859-1
721          (previous.is_some() && loop_current.charsetEncoderIndex != previous.as_ref()?.charsetEncoderIndex);
722
723            if needECI {
724                containsECI = true;
725            }
726
727            if previous.is_none() || previous.as_ref()?.mode != loop_current.mode || needECI {
728                list.push(RXingResultNode::new(
729                    loop_current.mode,
730                    loop_current.fromPosition,
731                    loop_current.charsetEncoderIndex,
732                    length,
733                    encoders.clone(),
734                    stringToEncode.clone(),
735                    version,
736                ));
737                length = 0;
738            }
739
740            if needECI {
741                list.push(RXingResultNode::new(
742                    Mode::ECI,
743                    loop_current.fromPosition,
744                    loop_current.charsetEncoderIndex,
745                    0,
746                    encoders.clone(),
747                    stringToEncode.clone(),
748                    version,
749                ));
750            }
751            current = previous;
752        }
753
754        // prepend FNC1 if needed. If the bits contain an ECI then the FNC1 must be preceeded by an ECI.
755        // If there is no ECI at the beginning then we put an ECI to the default charset (ISO-8859-1)
756        if isGS1 {
757            if let Some(first) = list.first() {
758                if first.mode != Mode::ECI && containsECI {
759                    // prepend a default character set ECI
760                    list.push(RXingResultNode::new(
761                        Mode::ECI,
762                        0,
763                        0,
764                        0,
765                        encoders.clone(),
766                        stringToEncode.clone(),
767                        version,
768                    ));
769                }
770            }
771
772            if let Some(first) = list.first() {
773                // prepend or insert a FNC1_FIRST_POSITION after the ECI (if any)
774                if first.mode != Mode::ECI {
775                    //&& containsECI {
776                    list.insert(
777                        if first.mode != Mode::ECI {
778                            //first
779                            list.len()
780                        } else {
781                            //second
782                            list.len() - 1
783                        },
784                        RXingResultNode::new(
785                            Mode::FNC1_FIRST_POSITION,
786                            0,
787                            0,
788                            0,
789                            encoders,
790                            stringToEncode,
791                            version,
792                        ),
793                    );
794                }
795            }
796        }
797
798        // set version to smallest version into which the bits fit.
799        let mut versionNumber = version.getVersionNumber();
800        let (lowerLimit, upperLimit) = match MinimalEncoder::getVersionSize(version) {
801            VersionSize::SMALL => (1, 9),
802            VersionSize::MEDIUM => (10, 26),
803            _ => (27, 40),
804        };
805
806        let size = Self::internal_static_get_size(version, &list);
807        // increase version if needed
808        while versionNumber < upperLimit
809            && !qrcode_encoder::willFit(
810                size,
811                Version::getVersionForNumber(versionNumber).ok()?,
812                ecLevel,
813            )
814        {
815            versionNumber += 1;
816        }
817        // shrink version if possible
818        while versionNumber > lowerLimit
819            && qrcode_encoder::willFit(
820                size,
821                Version::getVersionForNumber(versionNumber - 1).ok()?,
822                ecLevel,
823            )
824        {
825            versionNumber -= 1;
826        }
827        let version = Version::getVersionForNumber(versionNumber).ok()?;
828        list.reverse();
829        Some(Self { list, version })
830    }
831
832    /**
833     * returns the size in bits
834     */
835    pub fn getSize(&self) -> u32 {
836        self.getSizeLocal(self.version)
837    }
838
839    fn getSizeLocal(&self, version: VersionRef) -> u32 {
840        let result = self
841            .list
842            .iter()
843            .fold(0, |acc, node| acc + node.getSize(version));
844        result
845    }
846
847    fn internal_static_get_size(version: VersionRef, list: &[RXingResultNode]) -> u32 {
848        let result = list.iter().fold(0, |acc, node| acc + node.getSize(version));
849        result
850    }
851
852    /**
853     * appends the bits
854     */
855    pub fn getBits(&self, bits: &mut BitArray) -> Result<()> {
856        for resultNode in &self.list {
857            resultNode.getBits(bits)?;
858        }
859        Ok(())
860    }
861
862    pub fn getVersion(&self) -> VersionRef {
863        self.version
864    }
865}
866
867impl fmt::Display for RXingResultList {
868    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
869        let mut result = String::new();
870        let mut previous = None;
871        for current in &self.list {
872            // for (RXingResultNode current : list) {
873            if previous.is_some() {
874                result.push(',');
875            }
876            result.push_str(&current.to_string());
877            previous = Some(current);
878        }
879        write!(f, "{result}")
880    }
881}

883#[derive(Clone)]
884struct RXingResultNode {
885    mode: Mode,
886    fromPosition: usize,
887    charsetEncoderIndex: usize,
888    characterLength: u32,
889    encoders: ECIEncoderSet,
890    version: VersionRef,
891    stringToEncode: Vec<String>,
892}
893
894impl RXingResultNode {
895    pub fn new(
896        mode: Mode,
897        fromPosition: usize,
898        charsetEncoderIndex: usize,
899        characterLength: u32,
900        encoders: ECIEncoderSet,
901        stringToEncode: Vec<String>,
902        version: VersionRef,
903    ) -> Self {
904        Self {
905            mode,
906            fromPosition,
907            charsetEncoderIndex,
908            characterLength,
909            encoders,
910            stringToEncode,
911            version,
912        }
913    }
914
915    /**
916     * returns the size in bits
917     */
918    fn getSize(&self, version: &Version) -> u32 {
919        let mut size = 4 + self.mode.getCharacterCountBits(version) as u32;
920        match self.mode {
921            Mode::NUMERIC => {
922                size += (self.characterLength / 3) * 10;
923                let rest = self.characterLength % 3;
924                size += if rest == 1 {
925                    4
926                } else if rest == 2 {
927                    7
928                } else {
929                    0
930                };
931            }
932            Mode::ALPHANUMERIC => {
933                size += (self.characterLength / 2) * 11;
934                size += if (self.characterLength % 2) == 1 {
935                    6
936                } else {
937                    0
938                };
939            }
940            Mode::BYTE => size += 8 * self.getCharacterCountIndicator(),
941            Mode::ECI => size += 8,
942            Mode::KANJI => size += 13 * self.characterLength,
943            _ => {}
944        }
945        // switch (mode) {
946        // case KANJI:
947        //   size += 13 * characterLength;
948        //   break;
949        // case ALPHANUMERIC:
950        //   size += (characterLength / 2) * 11;
951        //   size += (characterLength % 2) == 1 ? 6 : 0;
952        //   break;
953        // case NUMERIC:
954        //   size += (characterLength / 3) * 10;
955        //   int rest = characterLength % 3;
956        //   size += rest == 1 ? 4 : rest == 2 ? 7 : 0;
957        //   break;
958        // case BYTE:
959        //   size += 8 * getCharacterCountIndicator();
960        //   break;
961        // case ECI:
962        //   size += 8; // the ECI assignment numbers for ISO-8859-x, UTF-8 and UTF-16 are all 8 bit long
963        // }
964        size
965    }
966
967    /**
968     * returns the length in characters according to the specification (differs from getCharacterLength() in BYTE mode
969     * for multi byte encoded characters)
970     */
971    fn getCharacterCountIndicator(&self) -> u32 {
972        if self.mode == Mode::BYTE {
973            self.encoders
974                .encode_string(
975                    &(self
976                        .stringToEncode
977                        .iter()
978                        .skip(self.fromPosition)
979                        .take(self.characterLength as usize)
980                        .map(|s| s.as_str())
981                        .collect::<String>()),
982                    self.charsetEncoderIndex,
983                )
984                .unwrap_or_default()
985                .len() as u32
986        } else {
987            self.characterLength
988        }
989    }
990
991    /**
992     * appends the bits
993     */
994    fn getBits(&self, bits: &mut BitArray) -> Result<()> {
995        bits.appendBits(self.mode.getBits() as BitFieldBaseType, 4)?;
996        if self.characterLength > 0 {
997            let length = self.getCharacterCountIndicator();
998            bits.appendBits(
999                length as BitFieldBaseType,
1000                self.mode.getCharacterCountBits(self.version) as usize,
1001            )?;
1002        }
1003        if self.mode == Mode::ECI {
1004            bits.appendBits(
1005                self.encoders.get_eci(self.charsetEncoderIndex) as BitFieldBaseType,
1006                8,
1007            )?;
1008        } else if self.characterLength > 0 {
1009            // append data
1010            qrcode_encoder::appendBytes(
1011                &(self
1012                    .stringToEncode
1013                    .iter()
1014                    .skip(self.fromPosition)
1015                    .take(self.characterLength as usize)
1016                    .map(|s| s.as_str())
1017                    .collect::<String>()),
1018                self.mode,
1019                bits,
1020                self.encoders
1021                    .getCharset(self.charsetEncoderIndex)
1022                    .ok_or(Exceptions::WRITER)?,
1023            )?;
1024        }
1025        Ok(())
1026    }
1027
1028    fn makePrintable(s: &str) -> String {
1029        let mut result = Vec::new();
1030        for ch in s.chars() {
1031            if (ch as u32) < 32 || (ch as u32) > 126 {
1032                result.push('.');
1033            } else {
1034                result.push(ch);
1035            }
1036        }
1037        result.iter().collect()
1038    }
1039}
1040
1041impl fmt::Display for RXingResultNode {
1042    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
1043        let mut result = String::new();
1044        result.push_str(&format!("{:?}", self.mode));
1045        result.push('(');
1046        if self.mode == Mode::ECI {
1047            result.push_str(
1048                self.encoders
1049                    .getCharset(self.charsetEncoderIndex)
1050                    .ok_or(fmt::Error)?
1051                    .get_charset_name(),
1052            );
1053        } else {
1054            let sub_string: String = self
1055                .stringToEncode
1056                .iter()
1057                .skip(self.fromPosition)
1058                .take(self.characterLength as usize)
1059                .map(String::from)
1060                .collect();
1061            // result.push_str(&Self::makePrintable(
1062            //     &self.stringToEncode[self.fromPosition as usize
1063            //         ..(self.fromPosition + self.characterLength as usize)],
1064            // ));
1065            result.push_str(&Self::makePrintable(&sub_string));
1066        }
1067        result.push(')');
1068
1069        write!(f, "{result}")
1070    }
1071}
